metadata.description: Professional video upscaling powered by Topaz Labs. Precision models (Proteus, Artemis, Iris, Dione, Theia, Gaia, Rhea)

info.title: Queue OpenAPI for topaz/upscale/video/precision
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the topaz/upscale/video/precision queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
# Topaz Precision Video Upscale

Classic (non-generative) upscaling and enhancement that stays
faithful to the source.

## Models
- **Proteus** — the default choice for most real-world footage.
- **Artemis HQ / MQ / LQ** — denoise and sharpen, for progressively
more degraded sources.
- **Gaia HQ / CG** — refinement for high-quality footage and CG
renders.
- **Gaia 2** — frame-by-frame 2x upscaling for animation and motion
graphics (billed at half price).
- **Rhea** — maximum fine detail via an internal 4x pass.

Videos are limited to 5 minutes. `target_fps` enables Apollo frame
interpolation only when it differs from the source FPS.

model.title: Model
model.description: Precision (non-generative) enhancement model. Proteus fits most real-world footage; Proteus Natural is a softer variant; Iris recovers faces; Dione deinterlaces legacy/interlaced sources; Artemis denoises and sharpens degraded footage; Gaia refines high-quality footage and CG (Gaia 2 upscales animation at 2x); Rhea maximizes fine detail via an internal 4x pass; Theia gives manual detail/fidelity control.

noise.title: Noise
noise.description: Noise reduction level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.

recover_detail.title: Recover Detail
